output_list.reason: The 'batchTransfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'cnt' is large, the multiplication 'uint256(cnt) * _value' will wrap around and cause a discrepancy between the sender's balance and the total supply of tokens.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balance of the 'from' address is large, the subtraction 'balanceOf[_from] -= _value' will wrap around and cause a discrepancy between the 'from' address's balance and the total supply of tokens.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balance of the 'to' address is large, the addition 'balanceOf[_to] += _value' will wrap around and cause a discrepancy between the 'to' address's balance and the total supply of tokens.

The 'batchTransfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is large, the multiplication 'uint256(cnt) * _value' will wrap around and cause a discrepancy between the sender's balance and the total supply of tokens.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the 'from' address's balance is large, the subtraction 'balanceOf[_from] -= _value' will wrap around and cause a discrepancy between the 'from' address's balance and the total supply of tokens.
